exposure: Misoprostol (400-800 mcg sublingually, orally, or vaginally depending on trimester)
outcome: Efficacy of medical termination of pregnancy
Safety of medical termination of pregnancy
Time to expulsion of dead fetus
cohort: A total of 500 women attending the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department at Nalanda Medical College and Hospital, Patna, seeking termination of pregnancy or labor induction, were included in the study.
finding: The study demonstrated the safety and efficacy of combined Mifepristone and prostaglandin therapy for medical termination of intrauterine pregnancy in Indian adult women across all trimesters, achieving a complete abortion rate of 96.4% and vaginal delivery in 90% of cases.
mod_finding: 90% of women delivered vaginally within 24-48 hours after induction of labor using the combined regimen.
gest_age: All trimesters: <13 weeks, 13-27 weeks, >28 weeks (with intrauterine death), and >40 weeks (for labor induction)
